checks: existing engine and real TapeOut circuit on an isolated X Layer fork
verified service registration and immutable metadata
execution, settlement, and indexer workers become ready
wallet authentication consumes one challenge under concurrent replay
scoped API keys are stored as hashes and cannot mint new keys
SDK executes JSON validation and independently confirms settlement
duplicate SDK execute recovers the original nonce and payment
SDK refuses gateway data that disagrees with the signed provider result
SDK refuses a fabricated settlement hash with a valid signed result
strict outer JSON and origin checks reject calls before reservation
session credentials cannot read or execute another customer's session
service credentials expose scoped analytics and cannot execute
API key expiry and revocation are enforced
successful negative JSON validation is billed, unsupported schema errors are not
delegated signatures cannot escape their service scope
PostgreSQL session locks prevent concurrent budget oversubscription
invalid request signatures and a reserved nonce are rejected before service execution
provider request-id caching survives a provider process restart
paid fixture AI results include verified raw-byte and usage receipts
in-flight gateway requests preserve their signed price version after a price change
historical SDK recovery verifies the old version without signing another charge
actual circuit denial after external spend preserves output without reporting a payment
a delegated key cannot authorize its own soft-limit override
a separate customer override authorizes the same retained charge
an interrupted provider completion remains indeterminate with its budget reserved
recovery retrieves the persisted provider result using the original request and nonce
a post-execution persistence failure retains the reservation as an unknown completion
indexer detects a reorg and stops billing readiness
indexer rebuild retains signed evidence and reuses the original settlement hash
one real Otari AI request verifies bytes, usage, useful output, and local settlement
expired indeterminate reservations are released only after settlement becomes impossible
unused balances refund to customers with exact token conservation
